parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
*M1: Resolve parallel to a slope at $A$ or $B$ to form an equation; correct number of terms; allow sign errors and trigonometric-function mix-up.
A1: $1.6g\sin50^\circ-T-F_B=0$. If the same friction force is used at both contacts, maximum M1A1A0B1.
A1: $T-F_A-1.2g\sin40^\circ=0$. The system equation $1.6g\sin50^\circ-F_B-F_A-1.2g\sin40^\circ=0$ alone scores M1A1A1; any sign errors score M1 only.
*B1: Either $R_A=1.2g\cos40^\circ$ or $R_B=1.6g\cos50^\circ$, explicitly linked to the correct contact (on a diagram or within resolving equations combined with $\mu$).
*M1: Use $F=\mu R$ at either contact: $F_A=1.2g\mu\cos40^\circ$ or $F_B=1.6g\mu\cos50^\circ$, explicitly linked as above; allow trigonometric-function mix-up error only.
DM1: Eliminate $T,F_A,F_B$ to form an equation in $\mu$ only: $1.6g\sin50^\circ-1.6g\mu\cos50^\circ=1.2g\sin40^\circ+1.2g\mu\cos40^\circ$.
A1: $\mu=(1.6g\sin50^\circ-1.2g\sin40^\circ)/(1.2g\cos40^\circ+1.6g\cos50^\circ)=0.233$; underlying value $0.23326119\ldots$.
Printed total: 7.
